text: Entry 1289 introduces --hub-menulist-* and --hub-menuitem-* variables for text, surface, border and selected state. The accepted stylesheet retains the local hub prefix and state names such as hover-focus-open, while using theme tokens. For this component family, recommend semantic local variable names and shared theme values when adding a state. This is a scoped style recommendation, not reviewer-approved global policy. The older TODO for dark mode is historical; no contrast, theme or live control inspection was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.
title: Account Hub menu styling has local semantic variables for its states
